data.title: Employment Fraud Metadata Feature Detection
data.description: Detects fraudulent job postings using metadata features from the EMSCAD benchmark (18,000 samples). Key finding: when both telecommuting and company logo flags equal zero, there is a 92% probability of fraud. Geographic concentration patterns (e.g., Bakersfield 15:1 fake-to-real ratio) provide additional signal. DistilBERT+SMOTE models achieve strong results; DNNs reach ~98% accuracy. This rule implements the high-confidence metadata feature checks that require no NLP processing.

detection.condition: (telecommuting == 0 AND has_company_logo == 0) OR (fraud_geographic_score > 0.8) OR (salary_experience_ratio > 3.0 AND has_company_logo == 0)

queries.sql:
-- SQL: Employment fraud metadata feature detection
-- Primary signal: telecommuting=0 AND company_logo=0 → 92% fraud probability
SELECT
    posting_id,
    company_name,
    job_title,
    location,
    salary_range,
    CASE
        WHEN telecommuting_flag = 0 AND has_company_logo = 0 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN has_company_logo = 0 AND has_company_profile = 0 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN location IN (SELECT city FROM fraud_concentration_cities
                          WHERE fake_to_real_ratio > 10) THEN 'MEDIUM'
        WHEN salary_range / NULLIF(required_experience_years, 0) > 3.0
             AND has_company_logo = 0 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'LOW'
    END AS fraud_risk_level,
    CASE
        WHEN telecommuting_flag = 0 AND has_company_logo = 0 THEN 0.92
        WHEN has_company_logo = 0 AND has_company_profile = 0 THEN 0.85
        ELSE 0.50
    END AS fraud_probability
FROM job_postings
WHERE posting_date >= DATEADD(day, -7, GETDATE())
  AND (
    (telecommuting_flag = 0 AND has_company_logo = 0)
    OR (has_company_logo = 0 AND has_company_profile = 0)
    OR location IN (SELECT city FROM fraud_concentration_cities
                    WHERE fake_to_real_ratio > 10)
  )
ORDER BY fraud_probability DESC
queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Employment Fraud Metadata Feature Detection")`
index=job_platforms sourcetype=job:postings
| eval fraud_risk = case(
    telecommuting_flag=0 AND has_company_logo=0, "HIGH_92pct",
    has_company_logo=0 AND has_company_profile=0, "HIGH_85pct",
    1=1, "REVIEW"
  )
| where fraud_risk IN ("HIGH_92pct", "HIGH_85pct")
| table _time, posting_id, company_name, job_title, location,
        salary_range, fraud_risk, telecommuting_flag,
        has_company_logo, has_company_profile

references: Organized fraud detection in 2026: a technical landscape report — Employment fraud detection
falsepositives: Small businesses or startups without established branding (no logo)
Legitimate remote work listings that don't flag telecommuting
Job postings in geographically concentrated industries
